2023-05-04
Claim received for a collision in which the insured vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant
is represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
2023-05-26
Reviewed the statements from the other driver and two independent witnesses, who all describe the collision in the
same way as the claimant. Scene photographs were obtained and are consistent with the reported sequence of
events.
2023-06-14
Police report confirms the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact. The driver is listed as a named
operator on the policy, and no coverage concerns have been identified.
2023-07-23
Vehicle inspection completed. Most of the damage lines up with the impact described, and no earlier damage to the
vehicle is known from prior records or the repair history reviewed so far.
2023-07-27
Medical records show a wrist fracture, which fits the type and force of a collision of this kind. Treatment followed a
typical course and tapered off as the claimant's condition improved. Records also show treatment to the same body
area within the past two years, and that prior condition is adding to the current complaints.
2023-11-17
Claimant has given the same account of the accident in each conversation to date, with no changes in the details.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
2023-12-10
File reviewed and considered ready for the next stage of evaluation. Counsel to be advised of the current findings,
and the medical and repair documentation will be requested in full.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
